notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
description:
Cast Scourge of the Skyclaves with kicker by paying {5}{B}{B}.
Scourge of the Skyclaves triggers, causing each player to lose life equal to half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Blitzwing triggers, causing an opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

uses.name: Blitzwing, Cruel Tormentor // Blitzwing, Adaptive Assailant
